installCommand: if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv pip install -r requirements.txt; else python -m ensurepip -q && python -m pip install -q --disable-pip-version-check -r requirements.txt; fi
buildCommand: cd frontend && corepack enable && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build && cd .. && if [ -n "$DATABASE_URL" ]; then python scripts/migrate.py; fi
